_about: On-device SQLite schema (v1) for Journey. Source of truth: lib/core/repositories/local/journey_database.dart. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, times HH:mm, timestamps ISO 8601 (same as .kiro/steering/api-contract.md).

eventCustom.mods: NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; 1 = user typed their own event

timeKeptDefault.mods: NOT NULL; 1 = user kept the predicted time

happinessKeptDefault.mods: NOT NULL; 1 = user kept the predicted happiness

eventKeptDefault.mods: NOT NULL; 1 = user kept the predicted event

text.mods: NOT NULL; final rendered journal sentence

wakeKeptDefault.mods: NOT NULL; 1 = user kept the default wake time

id.mods: PRIMARY KEY CHECK id = 1; single row

displayName.mods: NOT NULL; set by the assessment

entriesPerDay.mods: NOT NULL CHECK BETWEEN 1 AND 20; default 10

theme.mods: NOT NULL CHECK IN (system, light, dark)

_reflection_prompts_note: Not stored yet. Reserved for the post-MVP Insights feature (reflections). Carried over from the original Quick Journal prompt seed.

reflection_prompts.promptText: What is one thing you are grateful for today?
What was the most memorable moment of your day?
What is something new you learned today?

What is something you are proud of yourself for?

What would you do differently if you could repeat today?
What has been on your mind lately?
